nightly_orders_load drops rows with a timezone offset
- On 2026-02-19 the job lost 3204 rows because order_ts carried +05:30 and the parser assumed UTC.
- Parse the offset, then store UTC in warehouse.orders.
- Backfill the missing rows.

Loader discards offset timestamps
The nightly orders job silently skipped three thousand two hundred four rows (3204) on 2026-02-19. Timestamps with +05:30 were read as UTC. Handle the offset correctly before writing to warehouse.orders.
